subject: CIQA kickoff - perceptual compression labels as a product asset
body:
Team,

Kicking off CIQA formally. The open-source release gives us pairwise forced-choice human ratings over AVA images recompressed at two random JPEG quality factors, and I want to turn that into the canonical training signal for our perceptual compression metric. The product hook: media customers keep asking how far they can push bitrate before users notice, and NIMA-style aesthetic scores don't answer that.

Rough milestones inside our window: label pipeline reproducible by mid-March, second rater wave in May, launch review before June 1. Note the sampling constraint from the original study - only AVA images at JPEG quality factor 99 or above are usable as near-lossless sources, so the pool is a subset of the ~255k AVA images, not the whole thing.

Jelena will follow up on staffing and compute. Please flag conflicts with other commitments this week, not in April.

Thanks,
Lucia
